resources.string: Suggested transfers simplify net balances using a deterministic greedy method. They are not completed payments and are not guaranteed to use the fewest possible transfers.
No suggested transfers. Everyone is settled.
Correction overwrites amount/date without edit history. Parties cannot change. Retain/reduce the recorded amount; increases must fit this pair’s balance capacity with the old record excluded.
Record only a payment you have independently confirmed. Suggested payments and returning from a UPI app do not prove that money was transferred.
Possible duplicate: the same payer, payee and amount already appear on this UTC date. Record or save anyway?
Only the payer or payee, while a current group member, can record this transfer.
Unable to load settlements. Check group membership and try again.
Enter a positive amount within the displayed limit and a valid date. Balances or permissions may have changed; refresh and try again.
Recipient has no UPI ID. You can still record an independently confirmed payment.
No compatible UPI app or valid recipient UPI ID is available. You can still record an independently confirmed payment.
UPI opens with the full suggested amount shown above. Changing the record amount does not change that request. Returning or cancelling never records a payment automatically.
